title: 125 ### X. VICTIMS OF RAPE: The statistics of victims of rape were collected under three age groups viz., below 16 years, between 16 to 30 and above 30 years. 63% of the victims of rape were in the age group of 16 to 30 years while girls below the age of 16 accounted for 24%. The pattern of distribution is more or less same in different state and union territory with marginal variations in these percentages. The relevant statistics are furnished in table 55.
